style: Hand-drawn 2D cartoon illustration for a YouTube history explainer. Simple stick-figure people with large round plain white heads, black dot eyes, expressive eyebrows, small simple mouths, messy dark hair, thin black stick arms and legs, teal striped hide tunics with a tooth necklace; thick clean black ink outlines, flat bright colors with soft painterly shading, richly detailed painted cartoon backgrounds (caves, savanna, firelight, starry skies). Funny, gentle, not gory. 16:9 widescreen. Absolutely no text, letters, captions or watermark in the image. Compose for a vertical crop: keep the subject and action in the CENTRAL 4:3 area of the 16:9 frame.

shots.p: Extreme close-up of a cartoonish, cute tiny louse with big eyes clinging to a fur tunic thread, giant magnifying glass in front of it, warm cave firelight; funny not gross.
shots.line: Scientists used lice to work out when people started wearing clothes.

shots.p: A friendly stick-figure scientist in a lab coat holding a microscope slide up to the light with a shocked face, a cute louse waving from the slide.
shots.line: Yes. Lice.

shots.p: Hero shot: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) standing at a snowy cave entrance hugging himself, breath puffing white, a blizzard and frozen mountains behind, curious eyebrows raised.
shots.line: So how did cavemen stay warm?

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) shivering wildly with teeth chattering, icicles on his hair, snow up to his knees, a little bird huddled on his head, funny.
shots.line: Meet Moss. He's freezing.

shots.p: Cutaway illustration of woven fibres of a fur tunic magnified huge, cute cartoon lice living like tiny campers among the threads, cosy and silly.
shots.line: Surprise one: body lice live in clothes.

shots.p: Painted branching tree diagram made of glowing twigs (no letters): one branch with a cute louse on a head of hair, the other with a louse in a fur tunic, a giant ancient sun behind.
shots.line: Their DNA suggests they split from head lice at least eighty-three thousand years ago.

shots.p: The same branching twig tree stretching far back into a misty distance of older and older landscapes, a stick-figure scientist peering down it with binoculars.
shots.line: Maybe earlier.

shots.p: A row of ancient fur and hide garments hanging from a bone rack outside a cave, stone scrapers on a rock beside them, frosty morning.
shots.line: So clothes are old.

shots.p: A stick-figure caveperson scraping a big animal hide stretched on a wooden frame with a stone scraper, furs piled nearby, a reindeer herd in the snowy distance.
shots.line: They were likely made from animal skins and fur.

shots.p: A slender cream-coloured bone needle hovering in a spotlight like a treasure, sparkles around it, dark cave background.
shots.line: Surprise two: bone needles!

shots.p: Painted view of a cave mouth in snowy Siberian mountains with pine forest, an archaeologist's small trench inside where a bone needle lies beside a brush.
shots.line: The oldest eyed needles come from Siberia.

shots.p: The bone needle resting on a mossy rock while a giant round stone 'age' tablet with many tally-mark notches looms behind it, dusk light.
shots.line: They're about forty thousand years old, maybe more.

shots.p: Extreme close-up of the needle's tiny eye with a strand of sinew thread passing through it, a stick-figure hand guiding it, warm firelight.
shots.line: A tiny hole for thread, carved into bone.

shots.p: A stick-figure caveperson proudly modelling fitted layered clothing in a snowy camp: an inner soft fur layer peeking out under an outer hide parka, cut-away showing the layers.
shots.line: Surprise three: needles may mean layers.

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) holding up a small fur loincloth-style undergarment with a baffled grin, two cavepeople giggling behind their hands, cosy firelit cave; gentle and silly.
shots.line: Some scientists even wonder about Stone Age underwear!

shots.p: Painted reconstruction of three stick-figures lying peacefully in a burial on a snowy Russian plain, their clothes and caps sparkling with rows of thousands of tiny cream ivory beads, calm and respectful.
shots.line: Surprise four: in Russia, over thirty thousand years ago, three people were buried wearing ivory beads.

shots.p: An enormous heap of tiny cream ivory beads glowing like a treasure pile in the firelight, a stick-figure child gaping at it.
shots.line: More than thirteen thousand of them!

shots.p: Close-up of a hide tunic with neat rows of ivory beads being sewn on with a bone needle and sinew, stick-figure hands working by the fire.
shots.line: Many seem to have been sewn onto their clothes.

shots.p: Time-lapse style scene: a stick-figure bead maker carving tiny beads at a workbench while the sun and moon whizz across the sky behind and the bead pile slowly grows.
shots.line: Making them all took thousands of hours.

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) sitting by the fire with a bone needle, accidentally stitched his tunic hem to his own leg, tugging with a shocked face while a child laughs.
shots.line: And Moss? He tried sewing. He stitched his tunic to his leg.

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) snug in a beaded fur parka and layered boots beside a crackling campfire, holding up a bone needle proudly, snow falling softly outside.
shots.line: So Stone Age people stayed warm with fur, fire and clever sewing.

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) waving goodbye at the cave mouth at dusk in his new fur parka, a warm campfire glowing behind him and the first stars coming out.
shots.line: Follow for more Stone Age Stories.
